title: stk verify <service> [--expect-login <login>] --json
description: What `stk verify <service> --json` prints on stdout. stk exits non-zero on a failed verification and still prints this. Written from supertoolkit internal/verify/verify.go (`Result`) and internal/credcmd/verify.go. AgentPod's node-agent reads `ok`, `login` and `reason`, and accepts `ok: true` only with a zero exit and the login it expected (stkclient.go, Verify). A refusal before verification (no credential, an unknown service, `auth: none`) prints no JSON. On failure stk exits non-zero and writes `stk: <message>` to stderr; that text and the exit code are not part of this contract (phase 4, ruling 4).

login.description: The account the credential acts as; omitted when stk did not learn one.

reason.description: Why the verification failed; omitted on success. Stable strings: AgentPod records them.
